overall_intent: An unsettling winter orchard custom lingers across a domestic threshold after a woman returns carrying its drinking bowl; local visible traces should join the exterior custom to the interrupted return.

narrative_clue.reason: A visible event trace can make folk horror understandable in one frame, beyond cold color or an anxious portrait.
narrative_clue.expressive_goal: Show a surviving material connection between winter communal orchard custom and the domestic threshold.
observable_targets: A custom-related object or trace at the household boundary
A legible connection to orchard visitors or trees
owner_relations: Orchard branches own their tied ribbon traces
The doorway separates interior warmth from winter custom
required_constraints: A rural communal custom becoming unsettling
open_scope: Material state of a ritual object
narrative_clue.role_focus: Visible traces of a midwinter orchard wassail and visiting custom at a cottage doorway after the communal rite; a carried shared bowl and an attached tree ribbon connect the returning person to the still waiting orchard party.
narrative_clue.scene_context: A fictional adult reference-guided woman pauses inside an open cottage door with a wooden cider bowl in both hands. Bare ribboned apple branches and two torch witnesses remain visible outside. Warm domestic light meets blue winter dusk.

grounds.quote: A rural custom becomes unsettling during the return home.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The role is event evidence, not an inferred personality or an unsupported historic claim. The search intent comes from the independently frozen winter return scene.
